method: Lopez de Prado, Advances in Financial Machine Learning, Ch. 7 - combinatorial purged cross-validation with purge and embargo.
resampling: monthly (last close of each YYYY-MM wins; monthly return = px[i]/px[i-1] - 1)
note: Local SPY daily history resampled to monthly (60 months). The 33.8-year SPY monthly sample referenced in POWER_ANALYSIS.md is not present as a local file; this run used the available SPY price panel.
